g.aria-label: CenteredLayer: Y − Y.mean(); subclasses Module, 0 params, 0 buffers
RMSNorm: (x / RMS(x)) ⊙ g; registers gain g as trainable Parameter
RandomFeatures: √(2/D)cos(XW+b); registers W, b as non-trainable buffers
RoundSTE: forward evaluates round(x), backward passes upstream grad 1×
x + stop_gradient(f(x) − x) implements STE in 1 line across all frameworks
